best_idea: A write-time name blocklist kept as data: an ordered list of {pattern, reason class} rows compiled case-insensitively, first match wins, a class argument selects which rows apply, and a bounded retry generates clean random names.
decision_why: Frankendom rules a write-time display-name blocklist; keep rows-as-data, reason classes and first-match; add a word-boundary rule for short plain patterns (donor has 656 plain rows, e.g. dev, ct, mod) and check the final generated name (donor returns the last name unchecked after 10 tries).
acceptance: Loading the table rejects a plain dev row with no word boundary; with a boundary pattern, a character named Devon is accepted and Dev Team is declined with the developer reason; a generated name that still matches a profane row is never returned.
